test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall support the validation of project-specific critical extensions within the leaf certificate.
(extension value is incorrect or missing; certificate is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Read the certificate extensions of the certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. <DUT-side trigger for OID certificate provided by RD (X-e)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-e)>
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows no "X509v3 Certificate Policies: critical" line, or a "Policy:" line whose OID is not 1.3.6.1.4.1.57872.<…>
2. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-CertProvider-011 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
Polarion: NRL-349394
sibling axis: extension value; rule 1,3 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/N
asset: X-e — 2. PENDING: X-e OID certificate + trigger
asset: X-h — 2. PENDING: X-h log keyword
